questions.sentence: Rongali Bihur subhessa.
options: Apunako Bihur subhessa.
Moi bhat khau.
Mor ghor Jorhatot.
questions.correctAnswer: Apunako Bihur subhessa.
questions.translatedSentence: Happy Bihu to you too.

questions.sentence: Aji Bohag Bihu.
options: Today is Bohag Bihu.
Tomorrow is Bohag Bihu.
Yesterday was Bohag Bihu.
questions.correctAnswer: Today is Bohag Bihu.

questions.sentence: Apuni kenekoi ase?
options: Moi bhal ase, dhonyobad.
Moi Guwahatit thako.
Bihu bohag mahot hoi.
questions.correctAnswer: Moi bhal ase, dhonyobad.
questions.translatedSentence: I am well, thank you.

questions.sentence: Moi apunak subhessa janau.
options: I send you my good wishes.
I am going to your house.
I know your name.
questions.correctAnswer: I send you my good wishes.

questions.sentence: Tumi Bihu bhal pua ne?
options: Hoi, moi Bihu bohut bhal pau.
Nai, moi saah nakhau.
Moi tomar ghor najano.
questions.correctAnswer: Hoi, moi Bihu bohut bhal pau.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I love Bihu very much.

questions.sentence: Amar ghorot aji utsav.
options: There is a celebration at our house today.
There is a celebration at our house tomorrow.
Our house is near the festival ground.
questions.correctAnswer: There is a celebration at our house today.

questions.sentence: Bihut apunar ki lage?
options: Mok ekhon notun gamosa lage.
Mok kono kaam nai.
Moi etiya ghorot nai.
questions.correctAnswer: Mok ekhon notun gamosa lage.
questions.translatedSentence: I need a new gamosa.

questions.sentence: Mok olop saah lage.
options: I need a little tea.
I want a lot of tea.
I do not drink tea.
questions.correctAnswer: I need a little tea.

questions.sentence: Aji amar ghoroloi ahiba ne?
options: Hoi, moi sondhya ahim.
Nai, moi tomar naam najano.
Tumi kot thaka?
questions.correctAnswer: Hoi, moi sondhya ahim.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I will come in the evening.

questions.sentence: Bohag Bihu kitiya hoi?
options: Bohag Bihu bohag mahot hoi.
Bohag Bihu magh mahot hoi.
Bohag Bihu kati mahot hoi.
questions.correctAnswer: Bohag Bihu bohag mahot hoi.
questions.translatedSentence: Bohag Bihu falls in the month of Bohag.

questions.sentence: Magh Bihu jaarkalot hoi.
options: Magh Bihu falls in the winter.
Magh Bihu falls in the spring.
Magh Bihu lasts for one week.
questions.correctAnswer: Magh Bihu falls in the winter.

questions.sentence: Kati Bihu kiy alag?
options: Kati Bihut ami tulsi gosor tolot saki jolau.
Kati Bihut ami meji jolau aru bhoj khau.
Kati Bihut ami husori gai ghore ghore jau.
questions.correctAnswer: Kati Bihut ami tulsi gosor tolot saki jolau.
questions.translatedSentence: At Kati Bihu we light lamps under the tulsi plant.

questions.sentence: Durga Puja ahin mahot hoi.
options: Durga Puja falls in the month of Ahin.
Durga Puja falls in the month of Bohag.
Durga Puja goes on for four days.
questions.correctAnswer: Durga Puja falls in the month of Ahin.

questions.sentence: Apuni kun Bihu besi bhal pai?
options: Moi Bohag Bihu besi bhal pau.
Moi Bihu palon nokoru.
Moi Guwahatit thako.
questions.correctAnswer: Moi Bohag Bihu besi bhal pau.
questions.translatedSentence: I like Bohag Bihu the most.

questions.sentence: Bosorot tinita Bihu hoi.
options: Bihu comes three times a year.
Bihu comes twice a year.
Bihu goes on for three days.
questions.correctAnswer: Bihu comes three times a year.

questions.sentence: Guwahatit Durga Puja kenekua hoi?
options: Guwahatit bohut dangor pandal hoi.
Guwahatit bohut manuhe meji jolai.
Guwahatit etiya kono utsav nai.
questions.correctAnswer: Guwahatit bohut dangor pandal hoi.
questions.translatedSentence: In Guwahati they put up very big pandals.

questions.sentence: Bohag Bihu Asomiya notun bosor.
options: Bohag Bihu is the Assamese new year.
Bohag Bihu is the Assamese harvest festival.
Bohag Bihu is a winter festival of Assam.
questions.correctAnswer: Bohag Bihu is the Assamese new year.

questions.sentence: Uruka kitiya hoi?
options: Uruka Magh Bihur agor dinat hoi.
Uruka Bohag Bihur prothom dinat hoi.
Uruka Durga Pujar sesh dinat hoi.
questions.correctAnswer: Uruka Magh Bihur agor dinat hoi.
questions.translatedSentence: Uruka falls on the day before Magh Bihu.

questions.sentence: Apuni Bihut amar ghoroloi ahibo ne?
options: Hoi, moi niscoi ahim.
Nai, moi apunar naam najano.
Moi Bihu kitiya hoi najano.
questions.correctAnswer: Hoi, moi niscoi ahim.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I will certainly come.

questions.sentence: Moi apunak amar ghoroloi nimontron janau.
options: I am inviting you to our house.
I am going to your house today.
I have received your invitation.
questions.correctAnswer: I am inviting you to our house.

questions.sentence: Kailoi amar ghorot Bihur bhoj ase.
options: Bohut bhal khobor, moi niscoi jam.
Moi kali apunar ghoroloi goisilu.
Moi bhoj bonaboloi najano.
questions.correctAnswer: Bohut bhal khobor, moi niscoi jam.
questions.translatedSentence: That is wonderful news, I will surely come.

questions.sentence: Apuni poribarok loi ahok.
options: Please come with your family.
Please come alone tomorrow morning.
Please bring some sweets with you.
questions.correctAnswer: Please come with your family.

questions.sentence: Moi kiman bojat ahim?
options: Apuni sondhya sat bojat ahok.
Apuni bajaroloi sat bojat jaok.
Moi kailoi apunar ghoroloi jam.
questions.correctAnswer: Apuni sondhya sat bojat ahok.
questions.translatedSentence: Please come at seven in the evening.

questions.sentence: Mor kaam ase, kintu moi olop somoir babe ahim.
options: I have work, but I will come for a little while.
I have work, so I will not be able to come.
I will come as soon as my work is over.
questions.correctAnswer: I have work, but I will come for a little while.

questions.sentence: Tumi husorir dolot ahiba ne?
options: Hoi, moi tomar logot ahim.
Nai, moi git gaboloi bhoi khau.
Husori Kati Bihut hoi.
questions.correctAnswer: Hoi, moi tomar logot ahim.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I will come along with you.

questions.sentence: Nimontronor babe bohut dhonyobad.
options: Thank you very much for the invitation.
Thank you very much for the lovely gift.
I am sorry that I could not come.
questions.correctAnswer: Thank you very much for the invitation.

questions.sentence: Apuni ahibo nowarile mok kobo.
options: Hoi, moi apunak agotei phone korim.
Hoi, moi apunar ghor bisari pau.
Nai, moi apunar ghoror rasta najano.
questions.correctAnswer: Hoi, moi apunak agotei phone korim.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I will call you beforehand.

questions.sentence: Bihut apuni ki bonai?
options: Ami til pitha aru laru bonau.
Ami notun kapur kinu aru pindhu.
Ami pandal saboloi jau.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami til pitha aru laru bonau.
questions.translatedSentence: We make til pitha and laru.

questions.sentence: Aai etiya ghila pitha bonai ase.
options: Mother is making ghila pitha right now.
Mother has already made ghila pitha.
Mother knows how to make ghila pitha.
questions.correctAnswer: Mother is making ghila pitha right now.

questions.sentence: Apuni pitha khaboloi bhal pai ne?
options: Hoi, moi til pitha besi bhal pau.
Nai, moi pitha bonaboloi najano.
Pitha Magh Bihut bonai.
questions.correctAnswer: Hoi, moi til pitha besi bhal pau.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I like til pitha the most.

questions.sentence: Uruka ratit ami masor jool aru bhat khau.
options: On Uruka night we eat fish curry and rice.
On Uruka night we light the big bonfire.
On Uruka night we eat sweets and drink tea.
questions.correctAnswer: On Uruka night we eat fish curry and rice.

questions.sentence: Jolpanot ki dim?
options: Doi, chira aru olop gur diyok.
Bhat aru masor jool diyok.
Ekaap saah aru duta laru diyok.
questions.correctAnswer: Doi, chira aru olop gur diyok.
questions.translatedSentence: Serve curd, flattened rice and a little jaggery.

questions.sentence: Mok olop saah aru eta laru diyok.
options: Please give me a little tea and one laru.
Please give me a lot of tea and some pitha.
I would like tea without any sugar.
questions.correctAnswer: Please give me a little tea and one laru.

questions.sentence: Ei laru kune bonaise?
options: Ei laru mor aaitai bonaise.
Ei laru moi bajarot kinisu.
Ei laru mor babe kinise.
questions.correctAnswer: Ei laru mor aaitai bonaise.
questions.translatedSentence: My grandmother made these laru.

questions.sentence: Pitha bonaboloi pithaguri aru gur lage.
options: You need rice flour and jaggery to make pitha.
You need rice flour and coconut to make pitha.
Pitha is made only during Magh Bihu.
questions.correctAnswer: You need rice flour and jaggery to make pitha.

questions.sentence: Aru olop masor jool lobo ne?
options: Hoi, olop diyok, bohut bhal hoise.
Hoi, moi kailoi bajaroloi jam.
Nai, mok saah bonaboloi najano.
questions.correctAnswer: Hoi, olop diyok, bohut bhal hoise.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, give me a little, it has turned out very tasty.

questions.sentence: Bihur babe notun kapur kinisa ne?
options: Hoi, moi ekhon notun mekhela sador kinisu.
Hoi, moi kailoi bajarot kaam koru.
Nai, moi notun kapur bhal napau.
questions.correctAnswer: Hoi, moi ekhon notun mekhela sador kinisu.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I have bought a new mekhela sador.

questions.sentence: Moi deutak ekhon gamosa upohar dim.
options: I will give my father a gamosa as a gift.
My father gave me a gamosa as a gift.
I want to buy a gamosa for my father.
questions.correctAnswer: I will give my father a gamosa as a gift.

questions.sentence: Apuni Bihut prothome kar ghoroloi jai?
options: Moi prothome mor koka aaitar ghoroloi jau.
Moi prothome bajaroloi jau.
Moi ghorote thako, kotu najau.
questions.correctAnswer: Moi prothome mor koka aaitar ghoroloi jau.
questions.translatedSentence: First I go to my grandparents' house.

questions.sentence: Bihur dinot gutei poribar ekelog hoi.
options: On Bihu day the whole family comes together.
On Bihu day the whole family goes to the temple.
The whole family will come together tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: On Bihu day the whole family comes together.

questions.sentence: Bihut ami dangorok kenekoi sonman koru?
options: Ami dangorok gamosa di seva lou.
Ami dangorok notun kapur kini dou.
Ami dangorok phone kori subhessa janau.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami dangorok gamosa di seva lou.
questions.translatedSentence: We offer our elders a gamosa and take their blessings.

questions.sentence: Mor bhontiye mor babe ekhon notun sola anise.
options: My younger sister has brought a new shirt for me.
My younger sister wants a new shirt for herself.
I have brought a new shirt for my younger sister.
questions.correctAnswer: My younger sister has brought a new shirt for me.

questions.sentence: Tumar upohar mok bohut bhal lagil.
options: Tumar bhal lagil buli moi bohut sukhi hol.
Moi upohar khan bajarot bisari poisu.
Tumi mok kono upohar diya nai.
questions.correctAnswer: Tumar bhal lagil buli moi bohut sukhi hol.
questions.translatedSentence: I am so happy that you liked it.

questions.sentence: Notun kapur pindhi ami ghore ghore jau.
options: We wear new clothes and go from house to house.
We buy new clothes and give them to everyone.
We will wear new clothes tomorrow morning.
questions.correctAnswer: We wear new clothes and go from house to house.

questions.sentence: Apunar ghorot aji kiman manuh ahise?
options: Amar ghorot aji bis jon manuh ahise.
Amar ghorot aji kono manuh aha nai.
Amar ghor Jorhator ekebare kasot.
questions.correctAnswer: Amar ghorot aji bis jon manuh ahise.
questions.translatedSentence: Twenty people have come to our house today.

questions.sentence: Apunar kokaidewor biya kitiya hobo?
options: Aha magh mahot hobo, apuni niscoi ahibo.
Kali hoi goisil, kintu apuni aha nasil.
Moi biyaloi jaboloi bhal napau.
questions.correctAnswer: Aha magh mahot hobo, apuni niscoi ahibo.
questions.translatedSentence: It will be in the coming month of Magh, and you must come.

questions.sentence: Jodi apunar somoi thake, tente biyaloi ahok.
options: If you have the time, please come to the wedding.
If you have the time, we can go to the market.
Since you have no time, do not come to the wedding.
questions.correctAnswer: If you have the time, please come to the wedding.

questions.sentence: Biyat ki pindhim buli bhabi aso?
options: Moi mekhela sador pindhim, kiyono i bohut sundor lage.
Moi bhat aru masor jool khaim, kiyono mor bhuk lagise.
Moi biyar git gaboloi najano, gotike moi nagau.
questions.correctAnswer: Moi mekhela sador pindhim, kiyono i bohut sundor lage.
questions.translatedSentence: I will wear a mekhela sador, because it looks very beautiful.

questions.sentence: Biyar bhojot bhat, masor jool aru doi thakibo.
options: The wedding feast will have rice, fish curry and curd.
The wedding feast had rice, fish curry and sweets.
At the wedding we will only serve tea and pitha.
questions.correctAnswer: The wedding feast will have rice, fish curry and curd.

questions.sentence: Apuni biyaloi kiy aha nasil?
options: Mor deuta osusto asil, karone moi ahibo nowarilu.
Moi biyaloi goisilu aru bohut moja paisilu.
Moi apunak nimontron diboloi pahori goisilu.
questions.correctAnswer: Mor deuta osusto asil, karone moi ahibo nowarilu.
questions.translatedSentence: My father was unwell, so I could not come.

questions.sentence: Moi bhabisilu apuni ahibo, kintu apuni aha nai.
options: I thought you would come, but you did not come.
I did not think you would come, and you stayed away.
I will come only if you also come with me.
questions.correctAnswer: I thought you would come, but you did not come.

questions.sentence: Kailoi mor jonmodin, apuni ahibo ne?
options: Hoi, moi kaam sesh kori sondhya ahim.
Nai, moi jonmodin palon nokoru.
Moi apunar jonmodinor katha pahori goisilu.
questions.correctAnswer: Hoi, moi kaam sesh kori sondhya ahim.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I will finish my work and come in the evening.

questions.sentence: Amar notun ghorot kailoi puja ase, gotike apuni poribarok loi ahok.
options: We have a puja at our new house tomorrow, so please come with your family.
We had a puja at our new house yesterday, so you should have come.
We are still building our new house, so we cannot hold the puja.
questions.correctAnswer: We have a puja at our new house tomorrow, so please come with your family.

questions.sentence: Ei utsavbur amar babe kiy iman dangor?
options: Kiyono ei utsave amar gutei poribarok ekelog kore.
Kiyono ami bosorot tinita Bihu palon koru.
Kiyono Guwahatit bohut dangor pandal bonai.
questions.correctAnswer: Kiyono ei utsave amar gutei poribarok ekelog kore.
questions.translatedSentence: Because these festivals bring our whole family together.
